blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Timely and accurate crop health diagnosis is essential for sustainable agricultural production, yet accurate diagnosis often requires expert knowledge that is not readily available. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, and natural-language interaction, creating new opportunities for intelligent crop health assessment. However, deploying VLMs on resource-constrained devices remains challenging due to their substantial computational and memory requirements. This paper presents PlantVLM-Edge, a quantized vision-language framework for conversational crop health diagnosis that can run entirely on resource-constrained edge devices. PlantVLM-Edge combines agricultural domain adaptation, post-training quantization, and on-device serving with an offline chat interface, allowing growers to ask open-ended questions and receive diagnoses, symptom explanations, and management guidance without cloud connectivity. The framework is backbone-agnostic: we validate it with two different VLM types with varying scale and architecture (Qwen3-VL-2B and LLaVA-1.5-7B), four quantization schemes, and two diagnostic domains (plant diseases and insect pests), and we deploy all variants on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Eight-bit quantization affects answer quality minimally relative to the full-precision model, and 4-bit activation-aware weight quantization (AWQ) retains 98.6% of full-precision answer quality on both domains while reducing the weight memory of the 2B backbone by 49%. In its most compact form, PlantVLM-Edge requires 2.01 GiB of weight memory, returns its first token in about 0.12 s, and completes a 64-token diagnostic response in 0.78 s. These results demonstrate that timely and accurate crop health diagnosis is practical on edge devices, providing a foundation for next-generation crop monitoring and decision support systems.
blocks.zh: 及时和准确的作物健康诊断对可持续农业生产至关重要,但准确的诊断往往需要不易获得的专家知识。 最近的视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在视觉理解,推理和自然-语言交互方面表现出了卓越的能力,为智能作物健康评估创造了新的机会. 然而,在受资源限制的设备上部署甚高频仍然具有挑战性,因为它们需要大量的计算和内存。 本文介绍了PlantVLM-Edge,这是一个用于对话作物健康诊断的量化视觉语言框架,可以完全运行在受资源制约的边缘设备上. PlantVLM-Edge结合了农业领域适应,培训后量化,以及提供离线聊天界面的在线设备,允许种植者提出开放式问题并接受诊断,症状解释,管理指导而无需云连接. 该框架具有骨干不可知性:我们用两种不同VLM类型进行验证,其规模和结构各有不同(Qune3-VL-2B和LLaVA-1.5-7B),四个量化计划,以及两个诊断领域(植物疾病和昆虫),我们在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上部署所有变种. 八位分数相对于全精度模型影响答题质量最小,而4位活化-知重分数(AWQ)在两个域上保留了全精度分数答题质量的98.6%,同时将2B主干线的分数内存减少了49%. 在最紧凑的形式中,PlantVLM-Edge需要2.01 GiB的重量内存,在约0.12 s中还原出第一个活符,并在0.78 s中完成64个活符的诊断反应. 这些结果表明,在边缘装置上及时和准确的作物健康诊断是可行的,为下一代作物监测和决策支持系统奠定了基础。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Crop health underpins agricultural productivity and global food security, and protecting it depends on detecting threats early enough to act. Plant diseases and insect pest infestations are among the most persistent of these threats, accounting for annual crop yield losses of up to 40% ( Food and Agriculture Organization, 2026 ; Savary et al., 2019 ) . Early and accurate diagnosis is essential to limiting economic damage, yet in practice it still depends heavily on trained agronomists or plant pathologists ( Swanson and Rajalahti, 2010 ) , a resource that is often scarce, expensive, or simply inaccessible in smallholder and remote farming contexts. This gap has motivated research into automated and scalable approaches to crop health monitoring that can bring expert-level diagnosis to growers without direct access to specialists.
blocks.zh: 作物健康是农业生产力和全球粮食安全的基础,保护作物健康取决于及早发现威胁以采取行动。 植物疾病和昆虫虫害是这些威胁中最持久的,年作物产量损失高达40%(联合国粮食及农业组织,2026;Savary等人,2019)。 早期和准确的诊断对限制经济损害至关重要,但实际上它仍然严重依赖受过训练的农学家或植物病理学家(Swanson和Rajalahti,2010年),而这种资源往往稀缺、昂贵,或者在小农和边远的农业环境中根本无法获取。 这一差距促使人们研究对作物健康进行监测的自动化和可扩展的方法,这种方法可以将专家一级的诊断带给种植者,而无需直接接触专家。

blocks.en:
Deep learning-based computer vision has made image-based recognition of plant diseases and pests highly accurate on benchmark datasets ( Singh et al., 2020b ; Liu and Wang, 2021 ) , first with convolutional neural network classifiers ( Mohanty et al., 2016 ; Ferentinos, 2018 ) and more recently with transformer-based classifiers and detectors ( Meng et al., 2023 ; Tan et al., 2025 ) . However, models trained on curated images often generalize less well to field
conditions ( Singh et al., 2020a ) , and more fundamentally, they formulate diagnosis as a fixed recognition task. Their output is a class label or a bounding box, with no explanation of the visual evidence behind it and no way to ask follow-up questions. For non-expert growers, an isolated label is a major usability barrier, because it does not explain what the problem means or what to do about it. Addressing this requires models that go beyond passive detection to provide flexible, interactive decision support ( Novaliendry et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
基于深层学习的计算机视觉使得基于图像的植物病虫害识别在基准数据集(Singh等,2020b;Liu和Wang,2021)上高度准确,首先有革命神经网络分级器(Mohanty等,2016;Ferentinos,2018),最近还有以变压器分级和检测器(Meng等,2023;Tan等,2025.). 然而,接受过雕刻图像培训的模型往往不太能概括到实地
(Singh等人,2020年a),更根本的是,他们将诊断作为固定的识别任务。 他们的输出是一个类标签或边框,没有解释背后的视觉证据,也没有方法提出后续问题. 对于非专家种植者来说,一个孤立的标签是一个主要的可用性障碍,因为它无法解释问题的含义或对此应做什么. 解决这一问题需要超越被动检测的模型,以提供灵活、互动的决定支持(Novaliendry等,2026年)。

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs), which couple a pretrained visual encoder with a language model ( Ghosh et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) , offer a path toward such support. A single VLM can answer free-form questions about an image, from identifying a crop or pest to explaining likely causes and recommending management actions, and it can be adapted to a new domain by fine-tuning on question-answer data ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . Agricultural studies have adapted VLMs to crop disease and pest diagnosis through instruction tuning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning ( Awais et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Sharma et al., 2024 ; Kaur et al., 2025 ; Jena and Arjunan, 2026 ) , and benchmarks such as CDDM ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , AgMMU ( Gauba et al., 2026 ) , IP-VQA ( Jin et al., 2025 ) , and PlantExpertVQA ( Sakib et al., 2026 ) now evaluate diagnostic question answering beyond fixed labels. These studies consistently show that general-purpose VLMs improve substantially once adapted to the agricultural domain (Section 2.2 ).
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)将预先训练的视觉编码器与语言模型(Ghosh等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2026年)结合起来,为这种支持提供了一条道路。 单一的VLM可以回答关于图像的自由形式问题,从识别作物或害虫到解释可能的原因和建议管理行动,并且可以通过微调问答数据来适应新领域(刘等,2023;李等,2024). 农业研究通过指导调整和参数效率高的微调,调整了VLM,以适应作物病虫害诊断(Awais等人,2025年;Wang等人,2024年;Sharma等人,2024年;Kaur等人,2025年;Jena和Arjunnan,2026年),以及CDDM(刘等人,2024年b),AgMMU(高巴等人,2026年),IP-VQA(Jin等人,2025年)和PlantExpertVQA等基准。 (Sakib等人,2026年)现在评价诊断问题的回答,超越了固定的标签. 这些研究始终表明,通用的VLM一旦适应农业领域就大有改进(第2.2节)。

blocks.en: However, field deployments may prevent directly adopting large VLM toolkits due to resource constraints. In rural farming environments, unreliable internet connectivity, recurring cloud service costs, and data privacy concerns make on-device inference highly desirable ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . VLMs typically contain billions of parameters, which makes local execution expensive, and memory and speed remain limiting on edge devices. When run with llama.cpp inference framework, with its language model quantized to 4 bits, the general-purpose LLaVA-1.5-7B ( Liu et al., 2024a ) still occupied 4.7 GB and took about 20 s to answer a single question on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin and about 330 s on a smartphone ( Chu et al., 2023 ) , delays that are impractical for a grower awaiting a diagnosis.
blocks.zh: 然而,由于资源限制,外地部署可能阻止直接采用大型的甚高频工具包。 在农村农业环境中,不可靠的互联网连接、经常出现的云服务费用以及数据隐私问题使得非常可取的推断(Yao等人,2025;Yu等人,2025)。 VLM一般包含数十亿个参数,这使得局部执行昂贵,而内存和速度仍然限制在边缘设备上. 当使用 lama.cpp 推论框架运行,其语言模型被分解为4位时,通用LLaVA-1.5-7B(Liu等,2024a)仍然占据了4.7 GB,并用约20 s来回答NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin和约330 s在智能手机(Chu等,2023年)上的单个问题,延迟对于等待诊断的生长者来说是不切实际的.

blocks.en: Post-training quantization, which lowers the numerical precision of a model without retraining it, is a natural way to reduce these costs. However, existing edge evaluations of VLM quantization have used general-purpose models and benchmarks, and report that its speed benefits depend on the hardware and inference software (Section 2.3 ). How quantization affects the answer quality, memory footprint, and latency of domain-adapted agricultural VLMs on embedded hardware therefore remains largely unexamined, as does whether a compact VLM can match a larger one once both are adapted and compressed.
blocks.zh: 训练后量化法降低了模型的数值精度,而不对其进行再培训,是减少这些费用的自然方法。 然而,现有对VLM定量化的边缘评价采用了通用模型和基准,并报告说其速度效益取决于硬件和推论软件(第2.3节)。 因此,量化如何影响嵌入式硬件上经过域调整的农业VLM的解答质量、内存足迹和耐久性,以及紧凑的VLM一旦被调整和压缩,是否能够匹配更大的VLM,基本上仍然没有受到审查.

blocks.en: To address this gap, we present PlantVLM-Edge, a quantized vision-language framework for conversational crop health diagnosis that runs entirely on edge devices. PlantVLM-Edge consists of three stages: agricultural domain adaptation of a pretrained VLM through parameter-efficient fine-tuning, post-training quantization of the adapted model, and on-device serving with an offline chat interface that growers can access from a web browser on a local network. The main contributions of this work are as follows: • We develop PlantVLM-Edge, an end-to-end framework that takes a general-purpose VLM from domain adaptation to fully offline deployment, allowing growers to ask open-ended questions and receive diagnoses, symptom explanations, and management guidance without cloud connectivity. • We show that the framework is backbone-agnostic by instantiating it with two VLMs of different scale and architecture, Qwen3-VL-2B and LLaVA-1.5-7B, across two diagnostic domains: plant diseases and insect pests. • We systematically evaluate four post-training quantization configurations, spanning round-to-nearest, AWQ, and SmoothQuant at 8-bit and 4-bit precision. We measure both answer quality and on-device efficiency (weight memory, time to first token, inter-token latency, and end-to-end latency) on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. • We provide practical deployment guidance. Eight-bit quantization leaves answer quality essentially unchanged, 4-bit AWQ retains 98.6% of full-precision answer quality while reducing weight memory by 49%, and the choice of backbone affects deployment cost more than the choice of quantization method. The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section 2 reviews related work, Section 3 describes the datasets, the PlantVLM-Edge framework, and the evaluation protocol, Section 4 presents the results, Section 5 discusses their implications and limitations, and Section 6 concludes the paper.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们介绍了PlantVLM-Edge,这是用于对话作物健康诊断的量化视觉语言框架,完全运行在边缘装置上。 PlantVLM-Edge由三个阶段组成:通过参数效率高的微调来调整经过预先培训的VLM的农业域改造,经过调整的模型的训练后量化,以及提供离线聊天界面的在线服务,种植者可以从本地网络上的网页浏览器访问. 这项工作的主要贡献如下: 我们开发了PlantVLM-Edge,这是一个端到端的框架,将通用VLM从域内适应到全线下部署,允许种植者提出开放式问题并接受诊断,症状解释和管理指导而无需云连接. ^ 我们显示,该框架具有骨干-不可知性,它具有两种具有不同规模和结构的VLM,Qune3-VL-2B和LLaVA-1.5-7B,跨越植物疾病和昆虫这两个诊断领域。 我们系统评价四个训练后量化配置, 横跨相距最近, AWQ, 以8-位和4-位精度的平滑量。 在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上,我们既测量答题质量,又测量答题效率(重量内存、时间到先标、间接空档和端到端空档)。 我们提供实际部署指导。 八位分解的叶子解答质量基本不变,4位分解的AWQ保留了98.6%的全精度解答质量,同时将重量内存减少49%,选择骨干比选择分解方法更会影响部署成本. 本文件的其余部分编排如下。 第2节审查有关工作,第3节说明数据集、PlantVLM-Edge框架和评价协议,第4节说明结果,第5节讨论其影响和局限性,第6节结束文件。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 Computer vision for crop health diagnosis
blocks.zh: 2.1 作物健康诊断的计算机远景

blocks.en: Deep learning, and computer vision in particular, has become the dominant approach to automated crop disease and pest recognition. Early methods relied on handcrafted visual descriptors such as color, texture, and shape, combined with classical machine-learning classifiers such as support vector machines and random forests ( Sladojevic et al., 2016 ) . Subsequently, convolutional neural networks (CNNs), which learn hierarchical visual features directly from images, substantially outperformed these approaches once large labeled datasets became available. For example, Mohanty et al. ( Mohanty et al., 2016 ) trained CNNs on 54,306 PlantVillage images covering 14 crop species and 26 diseases, achieving 99.35% accuracy, and Ferentinos ( Ferentinos, 2018 ) extended this to 58 plant-disease classes across 25 crops with a best accuracy of 99.53%. However, these results were obtained on images captured under controlled conditions. When Mohanty et al. tested their model on images from other sources, accuracy fell to about 31%. Consequently, later datasets such as PlantDoc ( Singh et al., 2020a ) were introduced specifically to capture real-world field conditions. To address this challenge, subsequent work improved robustness through transfer learning, data augmentation, and field-acquired training images ( Thenmozhi and Reddy, 2019 ; Xu et al., 2022 ; Gui et al., 2021 ) . CNN-based object detectors, particularly the YOLO family, have also been widely adopted for localizing diseased regions and pests in real time, including on embedded hardware ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 深入学习,特别是计算机视觉,已成为自动化地识别作物病虫害的主要方法。 早期的方法依赖于手工的视觉描述符,如颜色,纹理和外形等,并结合了支持向量机和随机林等古典机器学习分类器(Sladojevic等,2016年). 随后,直接从图像中学习分级视觉特征的进化神经网络(CNNs)在大型有标签的数据集问世后,其性能大大超过这些方法. 例如: Mohanty等. (Mohanty等,2016年)对CNN进行了54,306 PlantVillage图像的培训,覆盖了14个作物物种和26种疾病,实现了99.35%的准确性,而Ferentinos(Ferentinos,2018年)将这一培训扩展到了25个作物的58个植物病症班,最精度达到99.53%. 然而,这些结果是在受控制条件下获取的图像。 当摩汉提等. 准确度下降到31%左右。 因此,后来采用了PlantDoc(Singh等人,2020年a)等数据集,专门用来反映现实世界的实地情况。 为了应对这一挑战,随后的工作通过转移学习,数据增强,以及现场获得的训练图像(Theymozzi and Reddy, 2019;徐等, 2022;Gui等, 2021)来增强稳健性. 基于CNN的物体探测器,特别是YOLO家族,也被广泛采用,用于实时本地化病区和害虫,包括嵌入式硬件上(Zhang等, 2024).

blocks.en: More recently, transformer-based architectures have been adopted for crop health diagnosis. The vision transformer (ViT) ( Dosovitskiy, 2020 ) divides an image into patches and uses self-attention to model relationships across the entire image, capturing global context that the local receptive fields of CNNs can miss. Pretraining on large plant image collections has proven particularly effective. For example, a ViT pretrained on PlantCLEF2022 achieved strong closed-set accuracy across four plant disease datasets and could also recognize disease classes unseen during training ( Meng et al., 2023 ) . For detection, transformer-based detectors following DETR ( Carion et al., 2020 ) remove hand-designed components such as anchor boxes and non-maximum suppression. M2DETR ( Tan et al., 2025 ) adapted this design to pest detection with a multi-scale denoising encoder, outperforming both CNN-based and transformer-based detectors on the IP102 pest dataset ( Wu et al., 2019 ) . Despite these architectural advances, both CNN and transformer-based approaches formulate crop health diagnosis as a fixed recognition or detection problem: their output is a class label, a bounding box, or a segmented region, with no explanation of the underlying visual evidence and no support for follow-up questions. This limitation motivates the use of vision-language models, reviewed in the next subsection.
blocks.zh: 最近,采用了以变压器为基础的结构进行作物健康诊断。 视觉变相器(ViT)(多索维茨基,2020年)将一幅图像分成了补丁并使用自觉来在整个图像中建模关系,捕捉了CNN的局部可接受领域可能错过的全球背景. 事实证明,对大型植物图像收集的预先培训特别有效。 例如,PlantCLEF2022上的ViT预训在四个植物疾病数据集中实现了强烈的封闭集精度,还可以识别在培训期间看不见的疾病课(Meng等,2023年)。 对于检测,DETR(Carion等,2020年)之后的变压器检测器去除手设计的组件,如锚盒和无最大压制. M2DETR(Tan等,2025年)将这一设计改编为多尺度去诺化编码器来检测害虫,在IP102害虫数据集上表现优于CNN和变压器的探测器(Wu等,2019年). 尽管这些建筑进步,有线电视新闻网和变压器方法都将作物健康诊断形成固定的识别或检测问题:它们的输出是一个类标签,一个边框,或者一个分块的区域,没有解释基本的视觉证据,也没有支持后续问题. 这一限制促使人们使用下一分节所审查的视觉语言模式。

blocks.en: 2.2 Vision foundation models in agriculture
blocks.zh: 2.2 农业远景基础模式

blocks.en: Foundation models are large neural networks trained on broad data at scale that can be adapted to a wide range of downstream tasks ( Li et al., 2024 ) . Their strength comes from the scale of pretraining. By learning from vast and diverse data, typically with self-supervised objectives that require no manual labels, they acquire general-purpose representations and knowledge that transfer across tasks and domains. As a result, a single pretrained model can be adapted to new tasks with far less labeled data than training from scratch would require, and in many cases it can perform tasks it was never explicitly trained for. Large language models (LLMs) illustrate this most clearly. GPT-3, with 175 billion parameters, performed a variety of language tasks from only a few examples given in its prompt, without task-specific fine-tuning ( Brown et al., 2020 ) . Parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) have further lowered the cost of adaptation by updating only a small fraction of a model’s weights.
blocks.zh: 基础模型是规模广泛数据培训的大型神经网络,可以适应广泛的下游任务(Li等,2024. 他们的力量来自于预训的规模. 通过学习广泛而多样的数据,通常具有不需要人工标签的自我监督的目标,他们获得了通用的表示和跨越任务和领域的知识。 因此,一个经过预先培训的单一模型可以适应新的任务,其标签数据远少于从零开始的培训所需要的数据,在许多情况下,它能够完成从未被明确培训的任务。 大语言模型(LLMs)最清楚地说明了这一点. GPT-3,有1,750亿个参数,只完成了它迅速给出的几个例子中的各种语言任务,没有针对特定任务的微调(Brown等,2020.). LoRA(Hu等,2021年)等参数高效方法仅更新了模型重量的一小部分,从而进一步降低了适应成本.

blocks.en: The same paradigm has been extended to computer vision. CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) learned to align images and text by training on 400 million image-caption pairs collected from the web, enabling it to classify images into categories described in natural language without task-specific training. The Segment Anything Model (SAM) ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) was trained on more than one billion masks across 11 million images and can segment objects in images it has never seen, and DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) showed that self-supervised pretraining alone can produce visual features that perform well across many downstream tasks. Vision-language models (VLMs) combine these advances with LLMs by connecting a pretrained visual encoder to a language model through a lightweight projector. Models such as BLIP-2 ( Li et al., 2023 ) , LLaVA ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , and Qwen-VL ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) can answer free-form questions about images, describe visual content, and reason about what they see in natural language, which makes them the most direct foundation-model counterpart to an interactive diagnostic assistant.
blocks.zh: 同样的范式被推广到计算机视觉. CLIP(Radford等,2021年)通过对从网络上收集到的4亿对图像封装对的培训,学会了将图像和文本对齐,使其能够将图像分类为自然语言描述的类别而无需进行特定任务培训. 分会任何东西模型(SAM)(Kirillov等,2023年)在1100万个图像中接受了超过10亿个口罩的训练,并且可以在它从未见过的图像中分会物体,而DINOv2(Oquab等,2023年)显示,单靠自我监督的预训就可以产生能很好地完成许多下游任务的视觉特征. Vision-language models (VLMs) 通过轻量级投影仪将一个预先训练的视觉编码器与语言模型相连接,将这些进步与LLMs结合起来. BLIP-2(Li等,2023年),LLAVA(Liu等,2023年),Quen-VL(Quen Team,2025年)等模型可以解答关于图像的自由形式问题,描述视觉内容,以及他们用自然语言所看到的东西的理由,这使得它们成为互动诊断助理最直接的基建-模型对应.

blocks.en: These capabilities have attracted growing interest in agriculture, where labeled data is costly to collect and diagnostic questions go beyond fixed categories. Vision foundation models have been applied to agricultural image analysis tasks such as segmentation and phenotyping ( Li et al., 2024 ) , while most work on crop health diagnosis has focused on adapting VLMs. AgroGPT ( Awais et al., 2025 ) used domain-specific instruction tuning to enable a general-purpose multimodal model to answer fine-grained questions about crops and diseases, and Agri-LLaVA ( Wang et al., 2024 ) introduced knowledge-infused training to build a multimodal assistant covering agricultural pests and diseases. Other studies have specialized VLMs for individual crops, including a BLIP-2-based model for tomato leaf disease diagnosis ( Kaur et al., 2025 ) and BananaVLM ( Jena and Arjunan, 2026 ) , built on LLaVA-1.5-7B, for banana diseases, while LLaVA-PlantDiag ( Sharma et al., 2024 ) explored conversational plant pathology diagnosis. A common finding is that general-purpose VLMs perform poorly on agricultural tasks without adaptation but improve substantially after domain fine-tuning. On the CDDM benchmark, for instance, fine-tuning raised the disease classification accuracy of LLaVA-1.5-7B from 5.9% to 91.8% ( Liu et al., 2024b ) . Benchmarks such as CDDM, AgMMU ( Gauba et al., 2026 ) , IP-VQA ( Jin et al., 2025 ) , and PlantExpertVQA ( Sakib et al., 2026 ) now support evaluation beyond fixed labels, covering species identification, symptom description, causal reasoning, and pest management. However, this body of work has focused primarily on adaptation and diagnostic quality, typically assuming access to server-class GPUs. How these models can be deployed efficiently on edge hardware, where agricultural diagnosis is ultimately needed, has received far less attention, as reviewed in the next subsection.
blocks.zh: 这些能力已引起人们对农业的日益关注,在农业中,标有标签的数据收集成本高昂,诊断问题超出了固定的类别。 愿景基础模型被应用于分化和麻黄等农业图像分析任务(Li等,2024年),而作物健康诊断的大部分工作则侧重于适应VLM. blocks.en: 2.3 Edge AI for agricultural applications
blocks.zh: 2.3 农业应用的边缘AI

blocks.en: Edge AI refers to running inference directly on devices located near where data is collected, rather than sending data to remote servers ( El Jarroudi et al., 2024 ) . In agriculture, this approach addresses several practical constraints: internet connectivity in rural areas is often limited or unreliable, field decisions benefit from low-latency responses, and farm data can remain under the grower’s control. Embedded platforms such as the NVIDIA Jetson family and the Raspberry Pi, along with smartphones, have therefore become common targets for agricultural vision systems. Most deployments to date have used CNN-based models, often made practical through lightweight architectures such as MobileNets ( Howard et al., 2017 ) and model compression ( Cheng et al., 2018 ) . For example, YOLO-based detection of aphid-damaged cotton leaves has been run in real time on an NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , and a portable plant disease detection system has been deployed on a Jetson Nano ( Yousif et al., 2025 ) . Adhikari et al. (2026) evaluated YOLO-based deer detection across multiple edge devices, including the Raspberry Pi and Jetson AGX Xavier, and UAV-based systems have integrated embedded hardware for on-site pest detection to guide precision spraying ( Chen et al., 2021 ) . These studies show that edge deployment of conventional vision models is mature, but the deployed models produce fixed outputs such as class labels and bounding boxes.
blocks.zh: Edge AI是指直接对位于数据收集地点附近的设备进行推论,而不是将数据发送到远程服务器(El Jarroudi等,2024.). 在农业方面,这种方法解决了几个实际制约因素:农村地区的互联网连接往往有限或不可靠,实地决策得益于低相关性的对策,而农业数据仍可由种植者控制。 NVIDIA Jetson家族和Raspberry Pi等嵌入式平台以及智能手机也因此成为了农业愿景系统的共同目标. 至今大多数部署都使用有线电视新闻网的模型,经常通过"移动网络"(Howard等,2017年)和"模型压缩"(Cheng等,2018年)等轻量级架构实现实用. 例如,以YOLO为基础的对被害的被害棉叶的检测在NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX(Zhang等,2024年)上实时运行,在Jetson Nano(Yousif等,2025年)上安装了便携式植物疾病检测系统. Adhikari等人(2026年)评价了基于YOLO的鹿跨多边装置检测,包括Raspberry Pi和Jetson AGX Xavier,而基于紫外线的系统整合了嵌入式硬件,用于现场病虫害检测,以指导精确喷洒(Chen等,2021年). 这些研究表明,常规视觉模型的边缘部署是成熟的,但被部署的模型会产生诸如类标签和边框等固定的输出.

blocks.en: Deploying VLMs on edge hardware is considerably more challenging. A VLM must encode the image with a vision encoder and then generate its answer token by token with a language model containing billions of parameters, so its memory and latency requirements far exceed those of a CNN classifier or detector. Recent work has begun to address this. MobileVLM ( Chu et al., 2023 ) designed compact VLMs for mobile devices and benchmarked them alongside LLaVA-1.5 on a smartphone and an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, with the language models quantized to 4-bit. Shin et al. ( Shin et al., 2026 ) evaluated component-wise quantization of several small VLMs, including Qwen3-VL-2B, on Jetson Orin NX and AGX devices, and found that 4-bit quantization greatly reduced memory use but did not necessarily speed up generation, with efficiency depending strongly on the hardware platform. On the software side, post-training quantization methods such as GPTQ ( Frantar et al., 2022 ) , AWQ ( Lin et al., 2024 ) , and SmoothQuant ( Xiao et al., 2023 ) , together with serving engines such as vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) , have made it practical to compress and serve these models without retraining. In agriculture, Kaur et al. ( Kaur et al., 2025 ) developed a BLIP-2-based tomato disease model targeting a portable greenhouse monitoring device, one of the few agricultural VLM studies to consider deployment hardware.
blocks.zh: 将VLM部署在边缘硬件上具有更大的挑战性. VLM必须用视觉编码器来编码图像,然后用包含数十亿个参数的语言模型以代号来生成其答录符,因此其内存和延迟要求远远超过CNN分类器或探测器. 最近的工作已经开始解决这一问题。 移动VLM (Chu等人,2023年)为移动设备设计了紧凑的VLM,并在智能手机和NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上与LLaVA-1.5并列基准,语言模型被量化为4位. 申等编. (Shin等,2026年)在Jetson Orin NX和AGX设备上评价了包括Quen3-VL-2B在内的多款小型VLM的组件分级,并发现4位分级分级可以大大减少内存使用,但不一定能加速生成,其效率在很大程度上取决于硬件平台. 在软件方面,如GPTQ(Frantar等,2022年),AWQ(Lin等,2024年)和SmoothQuant(Xiao等,2023年)等训练后量化方法,加上VLLM(Kwon等,2023年)等服务引擎,使得不进行再培训而压缩和服务这些模型成为实用. 农业方面,考尔等. (Kaur等人,2025年)开发出一种基于BLIP-2的番茄病模型,以便携式温室监测装置为目标,这是考虑部署硬件的少数农业VLM研究之一.

blocks.en: These studies leave an important gap. Edge evaluations of VLMs have focused on general-purpose models and benchmarks rather than domain-adapted agricultural models, while agricultural VLM studies have focused on diagnostic quality rather than deployment efficiency. As a result, the combined effect of post-training quantization on the answer quality, memory footprint, and latency of agricultural VLMs running on embedded hardware remains insufficiently characterized, and it is unclear which models and quantization configurations offer the best trade-off for field use. This work addresses that gap by building and evaluating a complete pipeline, from domain adaptation through quantization to offline conversational deployment, on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin.
blocks.zh: 这些研究留下了一个重要的空白。 脆弱性LM的边缘评价侧重于通用模型和基准,而不是适合域的农业模型,而农业脆弱性LM研究则侧重于诊断质量而不是部署效率. 因此,训练后量化对嵌入式硬件上运行的农业VLM的解答质量,内存足迹和耐久性的综合影响仍然不够突出,不清楚哪些模型和量化配置为实地使用提供了最好的取舍. 这项工作通过在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上建造和评价从域改造到量化到离线对话部署的完整管道来弥补这一差距。

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: We derive our datasets from two publicly available agricultural visual question answering (VQA) datasets: PlantExpertVQA ( Sakib et al., 2026 ) for plant disease diagnosis and IP-VQA ( Jin et al., 2025 ) for insect pest identification. Because PlantExpertVQA is too large to train on in full with our computational resources, we draw a stratified subset of it. IP-VQA is small enough to use in full after cleaning, and we group its questions into seven categories for evaluation. Figure 1 shows representative image-question-answer examples from both datasets, illustrating the range of questions they cover, from crop and pest identification to symptom description, causal reasoning, and pest management.
blocks.zh: 我们从两个公开的农业视觉问题回答(VQA)数据集: PlantExpertVQA 获得我们的数据集. (Sakib等人,2026年)用于植物疾病诊断和IP-VQA(Jin等人,2025年)用于昆虫识别. 由于PlantExpertVQA太大,无法用我们的计算资源充分训练,我们画出一个分层的子集. IP-VQA在清洗后足够小,可以完全使用,我们将其问题分为七个类别进行评估. 图1显示两个数据集中有代表性的图像问答实例,说明它们涵盖的问题范围,从作物和害虫的识别到症状描述、因果推理和害虫管理。

blocks.en: ( Sakib et al., 2026 ) is a large-scale plant disease VQA dataset comprising 765,186 expert-verified question-answer pairs over 150,841 images. It spans 38 crop species and 89 disease conditions, and its questions are organized into nine categories across three levels of cognitive complexity. The dataset is released with an image-disjoint 70/10/20 split into training, validation, and test partitions.
blocks.zh: (Sakib等,2026年)是一款由765,186个专家验证的问答组合组成的大型植物疾病VQA数据集,超过150,841个图像. 它涵盖38个作物物种和89个疾病状况,其问题分为9个类别,分为认知复杂性的3个层次。 数据集发布时采用图像分解式70/10/20分解为训练,验证和测试分区.

blocks.en: Training on the full corpus would have required substantially more computational time and resources, so we constructed a stratified training subset from the authors’ released training partition. Sampling was performed at the image level, so that all question-answer pairs belonging to a selected image were retained together and the splits remained image-disjoint. Strata were defined by the combination of crop species, disease condition, and source dataset, and images were allocated to strata in proportion to their size using the largest-remainder method. We also cropped the static black borders present in some images so that the model trained only on relevant visual content. The resulting training subset contains 63,546 question-answer pairs over 12,564 images, approximately 8% of the full dataset.
blocks.zh: 关于全员的培训本来需要更多的计算时间和资源,因此,我们从提交人释放的培训分区中建立了一个分层的培训子集。 取样是在图像级别上进行的,这样,所有属于所选图像的问答对被保留在一起,而分数仍然是图像相离的. Strata是由作物物种、疾病状况和源数据集组合而成的,图像是按其大小比例,采用最大的剩余方法分配给各层的。 我们还将一些图像中存在的静态的黑色边框进行裁剪,使模型只接受相关视觉内容的培训. 由此产生的培训子集包含63 546个回答对,超过12 564个图像,约占完整数据集的8%。

blocks.en: For evaluation, we used a stratified subset of 3,000 images from the released test partition, comprising 15,082 question-answer pairs. A separate set of 1,500 question-answer pairs from the validation partition was used for validation during training. Table 1 lists the number of evaluation pairs in each question category.
blocks.zh: 为了评价,我们使用了从释放的测试分区中分出3000个图像的分层子集,包含15,082个问答对. 在训练期间,从审定分区中单独使用一组1500个问答对. 表1列出了每个问题类别的评价对数。

blocks.en: ( Jin et al., 2025 ) is an insect pest VQA dataset covering 102 pest species, with approximately five question-answer pairs per image. Its questions address pest characteristics, pest categories, crop damage, and pest management practices. We removed pest classes with fewer than 10 images, to exclude severely underrepresented classes, and then removed corrupted images. This left 18,950 images and 94,785 question-answer pairs across 93 pest categories, which we divided into image-disjoint training (70%), validation (10%), and test (20%) sets. For category-level analysis, we grouped questions into seven evaluation categories by keyword matching on the question text; questions that matched no pattern were grouped as “Others”. Table 2 summarizes these categories.

blocks.en: 3.2 PlantVLM-Edge framework
blocks.zh: 3.2 PlantVLM-Edge框架

blocks.en:
Figure 2 provides an overview of PlantVLM-Edge. The framework takes a general-purpose pretrained VLM and prepares it for offline crop health diagnosis in three stages. In the domain adaptation stage, we fine-tuned the VLMs with LoRA on agricultural question-answer data.
In the compression stage, the merged model is quantized after training into lower-precision formats that reduce its memory footprint and accelerate text generation. In the deployment stage, the quantized model is served with vLLM on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin and accessed through a browser-based chat interface, allowing users on the same local network to query it without an internet connection. The framework is backbone-agnostic: any VLM supported by the fine-tuning, quantization, and serving toolchains can be used.
blocks.zh:
图2概述了PlantVLM-Edge。 该框架采用一个通用的预先培训的VLM,并准备分三个阶段进行离线作物健康诊断。 在域调整阶段,我们对农业问答数据与LORA进行了VLMs的微调.
在压缩阶段,被合并的模型在训练后被分解为更低精度格式来减少其内存足迹并加速文本生成. 在部署阶段,用一款NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上的vLLLM提供定量模型,并通过基于浏览器的聊天界面访问,使得同一局域网的用户可以在没有互联网连接的情况下查询. 框架为主干-可知性:任何由微调支持的VLM,量化,以及服务工具链都可以被使用.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Vision-language-model backbones
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 远景-语言模式主干线

blocks.en:
We instantiate PlantVLM-Edge with two open-weight, instruction-tuned VLMs
available on the Hugging Face Hub: Qwen3-VL-2B Instruct ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) and
LLaVA-1.5-7B ( Liu et al., 2024a ) . Both follow the standard VLM design of a vision encoder, a lightweight projector, and a language backbone, but they differ in architecture and pretraining. In particular, Qwen3-VL processes images at dynamic resolution, whereas LLaVA-1.5 uses a fixed-size CLIP input, so the two produce different numbers of visual tokens per image.
blocks.zh:
我们用两个开口量的 指令调制的 VLM 将 PlantVLM-Edge 带入
休克时可用 Face Hub: Quen3-VL-2B 教程 (Quen Team, 2025)并
LLaVA-1.5-7B (意大利语) (刘等,2024a). 两者都遵循了视觉编码器的标准VLM设计,轻量级投影仪,以及语言主干线,但在架构和预训方面都有所不同. 尤其是Qune3-VL在动态分辨率下处理图像,而LLaVA-1.5则使用固定大小的CLIP输入,因此两者每个图像产生不同的可视符号.

blocks.en: The two models were selected for three reasons. First, both are open-weight and reproducible, yet differ in architecture. Second, both are supported end-to-end by the llmcompressor quantization toolkit ( Red Hat AI and vLLM Project, 2024 ) and the vLLM serving engine ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) , which makes the full pipeline feasible. Third, they span the range of model sizes that can be deployed on our target device: Qwen3-VL-2B has approximately 2 billion parameters (a 16-bit weight footprint of 3.96 GiB), whereas LLaVA-1.5-7B has approximately 7 billion parameters (13.16 GiB). The two models therefore represent realistic deployment candidates at different points in the size range that fits on the target device, rather than a controlled comparison of model size: because they also differ in architecture and pretraining, our comparison addresses whether a compact model is sufficient for deployment, not how model size alone affects performance.
blocks.zh: 两种模式的选取有三个原因. 首先,两者都是可开放的重量和可复制的,但在建筑上却有所不同. 其次,两者均由llmpressor quantization工具包(Red Hat AI和vLLM Project,2024年)和vLLM服务引擎(Kwon等,2023年)支持端到端,这使得全管可行. 第三,它们跨越可以部署在我们的目标设备上的模型尺寸范围: Qune3-VL-2B有大约20亿个参数(一个16位重脚印为3.96 GiB),而LLaVA-1.5-7B则有大约70亿个参数(13.16 GiB). 因此,这两个模型代表了适合目标设备的大小范围不同点的现实部署候选人,而不是模型大小的可控比较:因为它们在结构和预训方面也不同,因此我们的比较涉及一个紧凑模型是否足以部署,而不是模型大小本身如何影响性能的问题。

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Domain adaptation
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 领域适应

blocks.en: The first stage of PlantVLM-Edge adapts the pretrained backbone to agricultural diagnosis. To efficiently specialize the models while preserving their pretrained knowledge, both models were adapted to each domain using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) ( Hu et al., 2021 ) applied to the language backbone, while the vision encoder, multimodal projector, token embeddings, and output head remained frozen. Specifically, adapters were inserted into seven projection layers: query, key, value, and output in the attention modules, and gate, up, and down in the MLP modules.
blocks.zh: PlantVLM-Edge的第一阶段将预训骨干与农业诊断相适应. 为了高效地将模型专门化,同时保留其经过预先训练的知识,两个模型都被用Low-Rank Adaptation(LORA)(Hu等,2021年)适用于语言主干,而视觉编码器,多模式投影器,符号嵌入和输出头则仍然被冻结. 具体地说,适配器被插入到7个投影层中:注意模块中的查询,键,值,和输出,以及MLP模块中的闸口上下.

blocks.en: The same optimization configuration (Table 3 ) was used for all four fine-tuning runs (two models × \times two datasets), and each model used its own native chat template. Furthermore, we trained for at most three epochs with early stopping on validation loss (patience of three evaluations) and kept the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss. All runs used a single NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB GPU. After training, the LoRA adapters were merged into the language backbone to produce a single fine-tuned checkpoint for quantization ( Hu et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 同样的优化配置(表3)被用于所有四个微调运行(两个模型×\times两个数据集),每个模型都使用了自己的本土聊天模板. 此外,我们培训的时间最多为三个时期,早期停止了鉴定损失(三次评估),并使检查站的鉴定损失最低。 所有运行都使用了单NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB GPU. 训练后,LORA适配器被合并为语言骨干,以产生一个单一的精细调节的分量检查站(Hu等,2021年).

blocks.en: For image processing, images were kept in their original stored form and processed online by each model’s image processor. For Qwen3-VL, dynamic-resolution processing was configured to produce between 128 and 256 visual tokens per image. In contrast, LLaVA-1.5 used its standard CLIP image processor, which resizes the shortest image edge to 336 pixels and applies a 336 × 336 336\times 336 center crop during both training and inference, producing 576 visual tokens.
blocks.zh: 在图像处理方面,图像以原存储形式保存,由每个模型的图像处理器在线处理. 对于Qwen3-VL,动态解析处理被配置为每个图像在128到256个视觉符号之间. 相形之下,LLaVA-1.5采用了其标准CLIP图像处理器,将最短的图像边缘缩放为336像素并应用了336×336\times 336中心收成,在培训和推想期间都产生了576个可视符号.

blocks.zh: 表3:微调配置. 优化设置在两个模型和所有微调运行之间共享;模型特定设置单独列出.

blocks.en: 3.2.3 Post-training quantization
blocks.zh: 3.2.3 培训后量化

blocks.en:
The second stage compresses the adapted model for edge deployment. After the LoRA adapters were merged, each fine-tuned model was quantized with llmcompressor ( Red Hat AI and vLLM Project, 2024 ) into four configurations spanning three techniques. Each configuration is named by the precision of its weights and activations: W8A16, for example, denotes 8-bit weights and 16-bit activations, and the suffix gives the quantization method. The configurations therefore differ along three dimensions: weight precision (8 or 4 bits), whether activations are also quantized, and whether calibration data are required. In every configuration, quantization was restricted to the linear layers of the language backbone, which hold most of the model’s parameters and must be read from memory at every decoding step ( Lin et al., 2024 ) . The vision encoder, multimodal projector, token embeddings, output head, and normalization weights were kept at 16-bit precision (BF16 for Qwen3-VL and FP16 for LLaVA), so that the visual features passed to the language backbone were identical across
configurations.
blocks.zh:
第二阶段为边缘部署压缩了被改造的模型. 在LORA适配器被合并后,每个微调的模型被以llmpressor(Red Hat AI和vLLM Project,2024年)被分解为跨越三种技术的四种配置. 每一个配置都以其重量和活化的精度来命名:例如W8A16表示8位重和16位活化,后缀给出了量化方法. 因此配置在三个维度上有所不同:重量精度(8或4比特),活化是否也是被量化的,以及是否需要校正数据. 在每一个配置中,量化被限制在语言主干线的线性地层,这些主干线层掌握了模型的大部分参数,必须在每一个解码步骤上从内存中读取(Lin等,2024). 视觉编码器、多模式投影仪、符号嵌入、输出头和常态权重均保持在16位精度(Qwen3-VL为BF16;LLaVA为FP16),因此传入语言主干线的视觉特性是相同的。
配置

blocks.en: RTN is the simplest form of post-training quantization ( Nagel et al., 2021 ) . For each group of weights, it computes a scale from the largest absolute weight in the group, divides every weight by this scale, and rounds the result to the nearest integer that can be represented at the target bit-width. Because the scales are derived from the weights alone, RTN requires no calibration data: it never runs example inputs through the model to decide how to quantize. We apply RTN at two bit-widths. W8A16-RTN uses 8-bit weights with one scale per output channel, and W4A16-RTN uses 4-bit weights with one scale per group of 128 weights; smaller groups give finer scales and therefore smaller rounding errors, which matters more at 4 bits. As the fastest and simplest method, RTN serves as the baseline against which the calibrated methods are compared.
blocks.zh: RTN是训练后量化的最简单形式(Nagel等,2021.). 对于每组权重,它从组内最大绝对权重中计算出一个尺度,将每个权重从这个尺度中除去,并将结果进行回绕到最接近的整数,可以被代表到目标位-width. 由于天平单从权重中产生,RTN不需要校正数据:它从未通过模型运行实例输入来决定如何量化. 我们在两个位宽处应用RTN. W8A16-RTN使用每输出通道一个比例尺的8位重,而W4A16-RTN使用每组128个重量一个比例尺的4位重;更小的组给出更细的比例尺,因此更小的四舍五入误差,这在4个比特上更为重要. 作为最快和最简单的方法,RTN是比较校正方法的基准。

blocks.en: At 4 bits, rounding errors become large enough to affect the model’s outputs. AWQ ( Lin et al., 2024 ) reduces this effect by recognizing that a small fraction of weight channels matters far more than the rest, namely those that multiply inputs with large activation magnitudes. It runs a small calibration set through the model to identify these salient channels and scales them up before rounding, so that they are quantized with less relative error. Like RTN, AWQ changes only how weights are stored, so the quantized model runs with the same 4-bit inference kernels and memory footprint. Our W4A16-AWQ configuration uses 4-bit weights with a group size of 128, calibrated on 128 question-answer examples drawn from 128 distinct training images.
blocks.zh: 在4比特时,四舍五入的错误变得足够大,足以影响模型的输出. AWQ(Lin等,2024年)通过认识到一小部分的重量通道比其他渠道重要得多,即那些能以巨大的活化量来相乘的投入的通道来减少这种效应. 它通过模型运行一个小的校正设置,以识别出这些显著的通道,并进行四舍五入前的分级,这样它们就以较少的相对误差被分级. 和RTN一样,AWQ只改变重量的存储方式,因此被量化的模型以相同的4位推论内核和内存足迹运行. 我们的W4A16-AWQ配置使用4位重,组大小为128个,校正了从128个不同训练图像中抽取的128个问答实例.

blocks.en: The weight-only methods above reduce memory but still perform all computation in 16 bits. SmoothQuant ( Xiao et al., 2023 ) also quantizes the activations, allowing matrix multiplications to run with 8-bit integers. Activations are harder to quantize than weights because a few channels contain large outliers, which would force a coarse scale onto all other values. SmoothQuant therefore first divides each activation channel by a smoothing factor and multiplies the corresponding weights by the same factor, which leaves the layer output unchanged but shifts part of the quantization difficulty from the activations to the weights. With a smoothing strength of 0.5, the difficulty is split evenly between the two. Both are then quantized to 8 bits, using dynamic per-token scales for the activations. W8A8-SmoothQuant was calibrated with the same 128-example protocol as AWQ.
blocks.zh: 上面的只重法会减少内存,但仍会用16位来进行所有计算. SmoothQuant (Xiao等, 2023) 也将活化分量,允许矩阵乘法以8位整数运行. 活性比重量更难量化,因为少数渠道包含出值大,这将迫使粗重的尺度进入所有其他值. 因此平滑量子首先用平滑因子将每个活化通道分出并用同因子将相应的权重相乘,这使得地层输出不变,但将部分量子化难度从活化到权重. 平滑强度为0.5后,两者难度平分. 两者然后被分解为8位,使用活化时的活化活化每位平分. W8A8-SmoothQuant被校正了与AWQ相同的128实例协议.

blocks.en: Table 4 summarizes the four configurations and the resulting weight footprint of each model. Quantization reduced the footprint substantially, and configurations at the same weight precision have identical sizes regardless of method, because the calibrated methods change which values are stored rather than how many bits are used. The relative reduction is larger at 4 bits and for the larger model, because the components kept at 16-bit precision make up a larger share of the compact model.
blocks.zh: 表4汇总了每种模型的四种配置和所形成的重量足迹。 量子化大大地减少了足迹,同样重量精度的配置无论方法如何,大小都是一样的,因为校正方法改变了存储的值,而不是使用了多少位. 相对还原量在4位和更大的模型上较大,因为保持16位精度的组件占了紧凑模型的较大份额.

blocks.en: 3.2.4 Edge deployment and serving
blocks.zh: 3.2.4 国家 边际部署和服役

blocks.en: The final stage serves the quantized model on the edge device and makes it accessible to users. Our target device is an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin Developer Kit, with a 12-core ARM Cortex-A78AE CPU at 2.2 GHz and 64 GB of memory shared between the CPU and GPU. A device of this class is the intended field platform: it requires no network connection to answer queries and keeps all data on the device. Because the memory is shared, it must hold the model weights, the key-value (KV) cache, and the serving runtime at the same time; reducing the space taken by the weights is precisely what quantization is intended to achieve.
blocks.zh: 最终阶段服务于边缘设备上被量化的模型并让用户可以访问. 我们的目标设备是一款NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin开发者 Kit,其12个核心的ARM Cortex-A78AE CPU在2.2GHz和64GB的内存由CPU和GPU共享. 此类的一个设备是预定的战地平台:它不需要网络连接来回答询问并保存设备上的所有数据. 由于内存是共享的,它必须同时持有模型权重,密钥值(KV)缓存,以及服务运行时间;减少权重所占用的空间正是被量化所要达到的目标.

blocks.en: To support real-time inference, each quantized checkpoint is served using vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) , which provides efficient KV-cache management and native support for the quantized formats generated by llmcompressor . Specifically, vLLM runs inside a container built for the Jetson’s CUDA 12.6 Tegra runtime. The model checkpoint is copied to the device, mounted within the container, and exposed through an OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint.
blocks.zh: 为了支持实时推论,每个被量化的检查站都使用vLLM(Kwon等,2023年)服务,它为由llmcompressor所生成的被量化格式提供高效的KV-cache管理和本土支持. 具体地说,VLLM运行在一个为Jetson的CUDA 12.6 Tegra运行时间所建造的容器内. 模式检查站被复制到设备上,被安装在容器内,并通过一个与OpenAI兼容的HTTP端点被曝光.

blocks.en: To provide a user-friendly interface, Open WebUI ( Baek, 2025 ) runs on the same device and communicates directly with the local vLLM server. Rather than interacting with the HTTP endpoint itself, users access the system through a browser-based chat interface that supports conversation history and voice input. As a result, anyone connected to the same local network can use the system through a standard web browser without requiring internet access. This fully offline architecture makes PlantVLM-Edge practical for field deployment and accessible to growers with little or no technical expertise.
blocks.zh: 为了提供方便用户的界面,Open WebUI(Baek,2025年)在同一设备上运行并直接与本地的vLLM服务器通信. 用户与其与HTTP端点本身互动,不如通过支持对话历史和语音输入的基于浏览器的聊天界面来访问系统. 因此,任何连接同一局域网的人都可以通过标准的网页浏览器使用该系统而无需互联网访问. 这种完全离线的架构使PlantVLM-Edge适用于外地部署,并且可供很少或根本没有技术专长的种植者使用。

blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.3 评价

blocks.en: We evaluate PlantVLM-Edge along two dimensions: the quality of its answers, measured against the reference answers of each dataset (Section 3.3.1 ), and its efficiency on the edge device, measured on the Jetson AGX Orin (Section 3.3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们按两个维度评价PlantVLM-Edge:根据每个数据集的参考答案测量其答案的质量(第3.3.1节),以及在Jetson AGX Orin上测量其边缘设备的效率(第3.3.2节)。

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Answer quality
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 国家 答题质量

blocks.en: Because the models generate free-form answers rather than selecting from fixed labels, no single metric fully captures answer quality. We therefore compare each generated answer with the dataset’s single reference answer using five complementary metrics, ordered from the strictest to the most lenient: normalized exact match (EM), which requires the complete answer to match; token-level F1, which measures word overlap regardless of order; ROUGE-L F1, which rewards shared words that appear in the same order; corpus BLEU-4, which measures the overlap of short word sequences; and BERTScore F1, which measures semantic similarity even when the wording differs. These metrics are widely used to evaluate generated answers in agricultural VQA and related tasks ( Sakib et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2020 ) . We use ROUGE-L as the primary metric throughout the paper, because it gives credit for correct answers phrased differently from the reference while remaining sensitive to word order, and because it is also reported by the authors of PlantExpertVQA ( Sakib et al., 2026 ) , which allows a comparison with their results.
blocks.zh: 由于模型生成自由形式答案而不是从固定标签中选择,因此没有单一的度量完全捕捉到答案的质量. 因此,我们将每个生成的答案与数据集的单一参考答案进行比较,使用从最严格到最宽松的五个补充度量:正常化的精确匹配(EM),这需要完全匹配的答案;象征级F1,它测量词重迭,无论顺序如何;ROUGE-L F1,它奖励在同一顺序出现的共享词;BLEU-4,它测量短词序列的重叠;以及BERTScore F1,它测量语义相似性,即使措辞不同。 这些度量衡被广泛用于评价农业VQA和相关任务中生成的答案(Sakib等,2026;Chen等,2019;Wang等,2020.). 我们把ROUGE-L作为整篇论文的主要衡量标准,因为它对正确答案给予了肯定,这些答案的措辞不同于参考,同时对文字顺序保持敏感,还因为它也得到了PlantExpertVQA(Sakib等,2026年)的作者们的报告,这可以与他们的结果进行比较。

blocks.en: The same scoring procedure was applied to both models on both datasets. Only the generated answer was scored: prompt tokens and special tokens were excluded, leading and trailing whitespace was removed, and neither the question nor the image was used by the scoring functions. For EM, token F1, and ROUGE-L, predictions and references were first normalized by lowercasing, removing ASCII punctuation, removing the articles a , an , and the , and collapsing whitespace. BLEU and BERTScore were computed on the unnormalized text with their own tokenizers. All metrics are reported on a 0-100 scale. BLEU is computed once over the whole evaluation set, whereas the other four metrics are computed for each question and averaged, so that every question contributes equally.
blocks.zh: 两个数据集的两个模型都采用了同样的打分程序。 只有所生成的答案被打出: 被排除出即时活符和特殊活符,去掉前行和后行的白空,被打分的函数既不使用问题,也不使用图像. 对于 EM, sorder F1, 和 ROUGE-L, 预测和引用首先通过降低分级、去掉 ASCII 标点、去掉文章 a, a, and the, 和倒塌的白空来正常化. BLEU和BERTScore是用它们自己的标注器在非正常文本上计算的。 所有衡量标准都按0-100的比例报告。 低浓铀是在整个评价组合中计算一次的,而其他四个衡量标准是针对每个问题计算和平均的,因此每个问题都具有同等的作用。

blocks.en: EM is the strictest metric: an answer scores only if it is identical to the reference after normalization ( Rajpurkar et al., 2016 ) . Let h i h_{i} and r i r_{i} denote the predicted and reference answers for question i i , and let 𝒩 ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathcal{N}(\cdot) denote the normalization function. For N N evaluated questions, EM = 100 N ∑ i = 1 N 𝟏 { 𝒩 ( h i ) = 𝒩 ( r i ) } . \mathrm{EM}=\frac{100}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\mathbf{1}\{\mathcal{N}(h_{i})=\mathcal{N}(r_{i})\}. (1) Because any difference in wording makes an answer count as wrong, EM is much stricter than the classification accuracy or consensus-based VQA accuracy reported in some studies, and its values should not be compared with them.

Two further analyses place these metrics in context. First, to measure the effect of domain adaptation, we evaluated the original Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct and LLaVA-1.5-7B checkpoints on the same evaluation sets without agricultural fine-tuning or in-context examples. Each model received the image, the question, and the corresponding domain instruction. Second, to identify which types of questions are most affected by quantization, we grouped question-answer pairs by category: nine categories for PlantExpertVQA (Table 1 ) and seven for IP-VQA
(Table 2 ). Within each category, the per-question metrics were averaged over its questions, and BLEU-4 was recomputed from that category’s answer pairs alone. Overall results were computed from all evaluated questions rather than as an unweighted mean of category scores, and questions sharing an image were treated as separate observations.

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Deployment efficiency
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 部署效率

blocks.en: For the plant disease task, we deployed all five configurations of each model, namely the 16-bit fine-tuned model and its four quantized variants, giving ten served models in total. For the insect pest task, we deployed two configurations as a cross-domain check; their weight footprint and latency closely matched those of the corresponding plant disease configurations, so the remaining insect pest variants were not deployed separately. All reported efficiency figures therefore come from on-device measurements of the plant disease models. All ten configurations were served with identical settings from the same container image, with a maximum model length of 2,048 tokens and a GPU memory utilization of 0.60.

blocks.en: We report the weight footprint, which characterizes memory, together with three latencies that follow the NVIDIA NIM benchmarking definitions ( NVIDIA Corporation, 2024 ) : time to first token (TTFT), end-to-end latency (E2E), and inter-token latency (ITL).
blocks.zh: 我们报告作为记忆特征的重量足迹,以及遵循NVIDIA NIM基准定义的三个后缀(NVIDIA Corporation,2024年):时间到第一标志(TTFT),端到端的后缀(E2E)和间接后缀(ITL).

blocks.en: We define the weight footprint as the device memory occupied by the loaded model parameters, taken from the log that vLLM reports when model loading completes. It depends only on the model and its quantization format. We deliberately exclude the memory that the engine allocates afterwards, such as the KV cache and the CUDA graph workspace, because these depend on the memory allocation settings and the required concurrency.

blocks.en:
All latencies were measured one request at a time, with no other requests running. Each request paired one image with the question “What disease affects this plant?”, drawn from 40 randomly sampled unique images from the plant-disease test set. Every configuration received the same 40 images in the same order, and caching was disabled so that each request began a fresh cycle. Three warm-up requests were run before each test and excluded from the measurements. We capped every answer at exactly N = 64 N=64 tokens so that output length was identical across configurations and end-to-end latencies are directly comparable.
Writing t 0 t_{0} for the time of submission, t 1 t_{1} for the arrival of the first generated token, and t N t_{N} for the end of the response, TTFT = t 1 − t 0 , E2E = t N − t 0 , ITL = E2E − TTFT N − 1 . \mathrm{TTFT}=t_{1}-t_{0},\qquad\mathrm{E2E}=t_{N}-t_{0},\qquad\mathrm{ITL}=\frac{\mathrm{E2E}-\mathrm{TTFT}}{N-1}. (8) As illustrated in Figure 3 , TTFT is the delay before the user sees any output: it covers request handling and the prefill stage, in which the image is encoded and the prompt is processed. End-to-end latency (E2E) is the time to the final token, spanning the whole request. Inter-token latency (ITL), also called time per output token, is the average gap between consecutive tokens once generation is under way. The first token marks the end of prefill rather than a decoding step, so ITL averages over the remaining N − 1 N-1 tokens, isolating the cost of decoding from the one-time cost of prefill. The three metrics combine as TTFT + ( n − 1 ) ​ ITL \mathrm{TTFT}+(n-1)\,\mathrm{ITL} , the time to produce an answer of n n tokens. We report all three as means over the 40 requests, with standard deviations for TTFT and E2E. The reciprocal of the mean ITL gives the per-user decoding rate in tokens per second, a restatement of ITL rather than a separate measurement.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: We report results following the stages of the PlantVLM-Edge framework. We first examine how domain adaptation changes answer quality relative to the zero-shot backbones (Section 4.1 ), then how post-training quantization affects answer quality on both datasets (Section 4.2 ), and then the memory and latency of each configuration measured on the Jetson AGX Orin (Section 4.3 ). Next, we combine the two to analyze the accuracy-efficiency trade-off and identify recommended configurations (Section 4.4 ). Finally, we present an example interaction with the deployed system using the recommended configuration (Section 4.5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们报告在PlantVLM-Edge框架各阶段取得的成果。 我们首先审查域适应变化如何回答相对于零射入主干线的质量(第4.1节),然后审查训练后量化如何影响两个数据集的答案质量(第4.2节),然后审查Jetson AGX Orin所测量的每个配置的内存和耐用性(第4.3节)。 其次,我们把两者结合起来,分析准确效率的取舍,并确定建议的配置(第4.4节)。 最后,我们用建议配置(第4.5节)与部署的系统进行互动。

blocks.en: 4.1 Effect of domain adaptation
blocks.zh: 4.1 域内适应的效果

blocks.en: Table 5 reports answer quality for the zero-shot backbones, the fine-tuned 16-bit models, and their four quantized variants on both datasets. Domain adaptation produces by far the largest change in answer quality in this study. On PlantExpertVQA, fine-tuning raised ROUGE-L from 15.45 to 78.18 for Qwen3-VL-2B and from 16.11 to 78.19 for LLaVA-1.5-7B, and exact match from below 2% to about 34% for both models. On IP-VQA, it raised ROUGE-L from 30.45 to 54.67 for Qwen3-VL-2B and from 26.25 to 54.41 for LLaVA-1.5-7B. The zero-shot models therefore answered in a form that differed substantially from the reference answers, and adaptation was essential for both backbones.
blocks.zh: 表5报告解答了零发主干线的质量,精细的16位模型,以及两个数据集上的4个被量化的变体. 领域适应在答复质量方面产生了迄今为止最大的变化。 在"PlantExpertVQA"上,微调后将ROUGE-L从15.45升至78.18分为Qune3-VL-2B,从16.11升至78.19分为LLaVA-1.5-7B,两个型号的精确匹配率从2%下至约34%. 在IP-VQA上,它将ROUGE-L的Qwen3-VL-2B从30.45提高到54.67;将LLaVA-1.5-7B从26.25提高到54.41。 因此,零镜头模型的回答形式与参考答案大相径庭,适应对于两个主干系统都至关重要。

blocks.en:
After fine-tuning, the two backbones reached almost identical answer quality: 78.18 against 78.19 ROUGE-L on PlantExpertVQA and 54.67 against 54.41 on IP-VQA, despite LLaVA-1.5-7B having more than three times as many parameters.
Absolute scores are lower on IP-VQA than on PlantExpertVQA throughout, at roughly 54 against 78 ROUGE-L, and exact match stays below 5%. This reflects the less templated answer distribution of IP-VQA, in which longer free-form descriptions make exact string agreement rare. BERTScore F1 changed much less with fine-tuning than the other metrics (for example, from 85.03 to 96.56 for Qwen3-VL-2B on PlantExpertVQA). This is largely a property of unrescaled BERTScore, which occupies a narrow, high range even for weakly related text (Section 3.3.1 ); its values are therefore most informative as relative comparisons between configurations.
blocks.zh:
经过微调后,两根主干线达到了几乎相同的解答质量:在PlantExpertVQA上的78.18对78.19 ROUGE-L,在IP-VQA上的54.67对54.41,尽管LLaVA-1.5-7B的参数是三倍多.
IP-VQA的绝对分数比整个PlantExpertVQA低,大约54分对78分ROUGE-L分数,准确的比分保持在5%以下. 这反映了IP-VQA较少模板化的答案分布,其中较长的自由式描述使得准确的字符串协议变得罕见. BERTScore F1在微调后的变化远低于其他的度量衡(例如,在PlantExpertVQA上的Quen3-VL-2B从85.03到96.56). 这在很大程度上是未调整比例的BERTScore的财产,即使对关系微弱的文本来说,BERTScore也占据了狭小而高的范围(第3.3.1节);因此,其数值作为组合之间的相对比较,最有参考价值。

blocks.en: Table 5: Answer quality of both backbones on the PlantExpertVQA and the IP-VQA test set. All metrics are reported on a 0-100 scale; higher is better. For each model, the best result among the fine-tuned configurations in each column is in bold.
blocks.zh: 表5:在"PlantExpertVQA"和"IP-VQA"测试集上两个主干线的答题质量. 所有衡量标准都按0-100的比例报告;更高的标准更好。 对于每个模型,每个列中微调配置中的最佳结果以粗体表示.

blocks.en: 4.2 Answer quality under quantization
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 解析后的答题质量

blocks.en: We next compare each quantized configuration with its fine-tuned 16-bit counterpart, which serves as the quality reference. Tables 6 and 7 report category-level ROUGE-L, giving the 16-bit score and the change under each quantized configuration, so that losses can be read directly.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来将每个被量化的配置与其精细调整的16位对应物进行比较,后者作为质量参考. 表6和7报告分类等级为ROUGE-L,给出了16位分数和每个分数配置下的变化,从而可以直接读取损失.

blocks.en: 4.2.1 PlantExpertVQA
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 工厂专家VQA

blocks.en: Both 8-bit configurations closely matched the fine-tuned model on all five metrics (Table 5 ): W8A16-RTN and W8A8-SmoothQuant scored 78.04 and 78.11 ROUGE-L against 78.18, and SmoothQuant marginally exceeded the reference on BLEU-4. At 4 bits, a small cost appeared, and the quantization method began to matter. W4A16-AWQ retained 98.6% of full-precision ROUGE-L, against 97.8% for W4A16-RTN, and outperformed RTN on all five metrics. Going from full precision to W4A16-RTN, ROUGE-L fell by 1.74 points and BERTScore F1 by only 0.31, whereas exact match fell by 2.85 points, or 8.5% of its value against 2.2% for ROUGE-L. Exact match is the most sensitive metric because any change in wording makes the whole answer count as wrong, whereas ROUGE-L and BERTScore give credit for partial and semantic overlap.
blocks.zh: 8位配置都与所有5个度量衡上的微调模型(表5)相近:W8A16-RTN和W8A8-SmoothQuant得分78.04和78.11 ROUGE-L对78.18,平滑Quant略微超过BLEU-4上的参考. 4比特时,出现了少量成本,量化方法开始重要. W4A16-AWQ保留了98.6%的全精度ROUGE-L,而W4A16-RTN则保留了97.8%的精度,并且在所有五个度量衡上都超过了RTN. 从全精度到W4A16-RTN,ROUGE-L跌了1.74分,而BERTScore F1只跌了0.31分,而准确的比分则跌了2.85分,即其值的8.5%,而ROUGE-L的比分为2.2%. 精确匹配是最敏感的衡量标准,因为任何措辞的改变都会使整个答案算作错误,而ROUGE-L和BERTScore则对部分和语义重叠给予肯定.

blocks.en: The category-level results (Table 6 ) show where this cost falls. At 8 bits, every category stayed within 0.6 ROUGE-L of full precision. At 4 bits, the loss was uneven: under round-to-nearest, it ranged from 0.28 points in Visual Attribute Grounding to 3.67 points in Comprehensive Description, with Plant Species Identification next at 2.36. AWQ recovered most of this loss in Comprehensive Description (from 3.67 to 0.93 points) and Counterfactual Reasoning (from 1.84 to 0.41). However, it trailed round-to-nearest in four of the nine categories, by between 0.03 and 1.58 points, most notably in Visual Attribute Grounding (a loss of 1.86 points against 0.28) and Existence & Sanity Check (1.57 against 0.32). The benefit of AWQ is therefore concentrated in long, explanatory answers, which matter most for a conversational diagnostic system.
blocks.zh: 类别一级的结果(表6)显示这一费用下降的地点。 8比特时,每个类别都完全精确地保持在0.6 ROUGE-L范围内。 在4比特,损失不均匀:在圆相到相近的距离下,从视觉属性地底的0.28分到综合描述的3.67分不等,接下来是植物物种识别为2.36分. AWQ在"综合描述"(从3.67分到0.93分)和"反事实原因"(从1.84分到0.41分)中收回了大部分损失. 然而,它在9个类别中的4个类别中走入了最近的一圈,在0.03至1.58分之间,最显著的是在视觉属性地平线(损失了1.86分,对0.28分)和存在与卫生检查(1.57分,对0.32分)中。 因此,AWQ的好处集中在长长的解释性答案上,这对对话性诊断系统最为重要.

blocks.en: Quantization was close to lossless across the entire range for the larger backbone (Table 5 ). Every configuration stayed within 0.33 ROUGE-L of full precision, BERTScore F1 varied by at most 0.06 points, and exact match by at most 0.37. W8A16-RTN was effectively identical to the fine-tuned model, and at 4 bits round-to-nearest scored slightly higher than AWQ (77.99 against 77.86). The category-level results (Table 6 ) were equally flat: no configuration fell more than 0.73 ROUGE-L below full precision in any category, the largest deviation being a 0.73-point loss in Counterfactual Reasoning under W4A16-AWQ.
blocks.zh: 对于更大的骨干而言,整个范围的量化接近无损失(表5)。 每个配置都保持在0.33 ROUGE-L的全精度以内,BERTScore F1在最多0.06分时各有不同,精确匹配在最多0.37分. W8A16-RTN实际上与微调型号完全相同,在4比特圆相距相距最近时,得分略高于AWQ(77.99对77.86). 类别级结果(表6)同样平平:任何类别中没有任何配置低于0.73 ROUGE-L的完全精度,最大的偏差是W4A16-AWQ下的反事实原因损失0.73分.

blocks.en: Although the two backbones reached the same quality at full precision, they differed in their sensitivity to 4-bit quantization: Qwen3-VL-2B lost 1.07 (AWQ) and 1.74 (RTN) ROUGE-L points, whereas LLaVA-1.5-7B lost only 0.33 and 0.20.
blocks.zh: 虽然两个骨干完全精准地达到了同样的质量,但它们在敏感度上与4位分数的分数不同: Qune3-VL-2B损失了1.07分(AWQ)和1.74分(RTN)ROUGE-L分数,而LLaVA-1.5-7B只损失了0.33分和0.20分.

blocks.en: 4.2.2 IP-VQA
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 IP-VQA

blocks.en: The 8-bit configurations again preserved answer quality (Table 5 ). W8A16-RTN scored 54.70 ROUGE-L against 54.67 at full precision, a negligible difference with identical BERTScore F1 (94.06), and W8A8-SmoothQuant scored 54.40. At 4 bits, the two methods separated more clearly than on PlantExpertVQA. Round-to-nearest lost 1.72 ROUGE-L, similar to its loss on the plant task in absolute terms, whereas AWQ lost only 0.76, retaining 98.6% of full-precision ROUGE-L, and outperformed round-to-nearest on all five metrics. AWQ’s lead over round-to-nearest was therefore wider than on PlantExpertVQA (0.96 against 0.67 points), and it recovered 56% of the round-to-nearest loss on IP-VQA compared with 39% on PlantExpertVQA.
blocks.zh: 8位配置再次保留了答案质量(表5). W8A16-RTN在全精度下打入54.70 ROUGE-L对54.67分,与同为BERTSCore F1 (94.06分)的相差可忽略不计,W8A8-SmoothQuant打入54.40分. 在4位时,两种方法的分离比PlantExpertVQA上更清晰. 圆相近损失1.72 ROUGE-L,与它在工厂任务上的损失绝对值类似,而AWQ只损失了0.76,保留了98.6%的全精相相相近的ROUGE-L,并且在所有5个度量标准上都超过了圆相相近. 因此,AWQ在圆相相近处的铅比在PlantExpertVQA(0.96对0.67分)上的铅要大,它在IP-VQA上回收了56%的圆相相近损失,而在PlantExpertVQA上则回收了39%.

blocks.en: This difference is consistent with the structure of the two datasets. PlantExpertVQA contains many repeated question and answer patterns, whereas IP-VQA has more varied questions and responses. Repetitive, templated answers may be less sensitive to coarse weight rounding, whereas more varied answers make the effect of quantization more visible, which also leaves more room for AWQ to recover. The category-level results (Table 7 ) show that the 4-bit degradation was broad rather than concentrated: under round-to-nearest, every category lost between 0.9 and 2.4 points, with Pest Control Methods the most affected ( − 2.43 -2.43 ). AWQ recovered part of this loss in six of the seven categories. The exception was Optimal Timing, the smallest category ( n = 345 n=345 ), where AWQ lost 1.87 points against 0.98 for round-to-nearest.
blocks.zh: 这一差异与两个数据集的结构一致. PlantExpertVQA包含许多重复的问答模式,而IP-VQA则有更多样化的问答. 重复的,模板化的答案对于粗重的重量四舍五入可能不太敏感,而更多变的答案使得量化的效果更加明显,这也为AWQ恢复留下了更大的空间. 类别一级的结果(表7)显示,4位降解是广泛的,而不是集中的:在从圆到近,每类损失在0.9至2.4分之间,受虫害控制方法的影响最大(−2.43-2.43)。 AWQ在7个类别中有6个类别收回了部分损失。 例外的是Optimal Timing,是最小的类别(n = 345n = 345),AWQ的比分相差1.87分而相差0.98分.

blocks.en: Quantization left answer quality essentially unchanged for the larger backbone (Table 5 ). Across all five configurations, ROUGE-L varied by 0.43 points and BERTScore F1 by 0.05. Both 8-bit configurations scored 54.43 ROUGE-L against 54.41 at full precision, with BERTScore F1 identical at 94.03. At 4 bits, round-to-nearest again scored slightly higher than AWQ (54.20 against 54.00). The category-level results (Table 7 ) were equally flat. Under 4-bit round-to-nearest, no category fell more than 0.9 ROUGE-L below full precision, compared with losses of 0.9 to 2.4 points for Qwen3-VL-2B on the same dataset. AWQ trailed round-to-nearest in six of the seven categories, most in Pest Identification ( − 0.69 -0.69 against − 0.31 -0.31 ), and SmoothQuant recorded the highest score in four of the seven categories by small margins.

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Summary across models and domains
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 (中文(简体) ). 跨模式和领域的总结

blocks.en: The four model-dataset combinations give a consistent picture. Eight-bit quantization changed aggregate ROUGE-L by at most 0.3 points in every case, regardless of method. Four-bit quantization cost between 0.3% and 3.1% of ROUGE-L, with the larger losses falling on the compact backbone and on the less templated IP-VQA dataset. The choice of 4-bit method mattered only where this loss was material: for Qwen3-VL-2B, AWQ outperformed round-to-nearest in both domains and retained 98.6% of full-precision ROUGE-L on each, whereas for LLaVA-1.5-7B the two methods differed by at most 0.2 points, with round-to-nearest slightly ahead.
blocks.zh: 四个模型-数据集组合给出了一致的画面. 八位分数化使ROUGE-L总和在每种情况下的分数变化了最多0.3分,无论方法如何. 四位量化成本为ROUGE-L的0.3%至3.1%,较大的损失会落在紧凑的骨干上和模板较少的IP-VQA数据集上. 4位方法的选择只有在这种损失是实质性的时才重要:对Qune3-VL-2B来说,AWQ在两个域的圆相比最接近,每个域保留98.6%的全精度ROUGE-L,而对LLaVA-1.5-7B来说,这两种方法最多在0.2分时不同,圆相比最接近。

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Memory and decoding speed
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 内存和解码速度

blocks.en: Bit-width determined both the weight footprint and the decoding speed (Table 8 , Weights and ITL columns). Configurations at the same bit-width occupied identical memory, and the two 4-bit configurations decoded within 0.1 ms per token of each other. The exception was W8A8-SmoothQuant, which decoded 1.2-1.3 ms per token more slowly than W8A16-RTN, consistent with the added cost of quantizing activations at every decoding step. Relative to 16 bits, the weight footprint fell by 33% (8 bits) and 49% (4 bits) for Qwen3-VL-2B, and by 46% and 68% for LLaVA-1.5-7B. The compact backbone compresses less because its unquantized components, namely the vision encoder, embeddings, and output head, make up a larger share of its parameters.
blocks.zh: Bit-width确定重量足迹和解码速度(表8、重量和国际交易日志列)。 在同一位宽的配置占据了相同的内存,两个4位的配置在相邻的每个令牌0.1ms以内解码. 例外的是W8A8-SmoothQuant,它比W8A16-RTN更慢地解码了每枚令牌的1.2-1.3 ms,这符合在每个解码步骤上将活性化的附加成本. 相较于16位,Qune3-VL-2B的重量足迹下降了33%(8位)和49%(4位),而LLaVA-1.5-7B的重量足迹下降了46%和68%. 紧凑的骨干压缩较少,因为其未量化的组件,即视觉编码器,嵌入器和输出头,在其参数中占据了更大的份额.

blocks.en: Decoding accelerated accordingly, with inter-token latency falling by 2.14 × \times for Qwen3-VL-2B and 3.11 × \times for LLaVA-1.5-7B. Each generated token requires the language-backbone weights to be read from memory, so fewer weight bits mean less memory traffic and faster token generation. The decoding speed-up does not exactly track the footprint reduction, because the footprint includes components that play different roles during decoding. The 16-bit vision encoder occupies memory but is not used after prefill, which is why Qwen3-VL-2B decoded 2.14 × \times faster even though its footprint shrank by only 1.97 × \times . The 16-bit output head, in contrast, is read at every decoding step and limits the attainable speed-up.
blocks.zh: 解码相应加快了速度,相接时空下降2.14×xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活 每个被生成的令牌需要从内存中读取语言-后骨重量,因此重量比特意味着内存流量减少并更快地生成令牌. 解码速度不完全跟踪足迹减少,因为足迹包括了在解码过程中起不同作用的组件. 16位的视觉编码器占用了内存,但在预填后没有被使用,这就是为什么Qwen3-VL-2B解码为2.14×\times的速度快,尽管其脚印缩小了1.97×\times. 相形之下,16位输出头在每一个解码步骤被读取并限制可实现的速度.

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Time to first token
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 国家 时间到了

blocks.en: Before a model can emit its first token, it must encode the image and process the prompt, a stage known as prefill (Figure 3 ). Quantization helps less here for two reasons: the vision encoder, which runs entirely during prefill, remains at 16 bits in every configuration, and prefill processes all input tokens in parallel, so it is limited by computation rather than by the memory traffic that dominates decoding. For Qwen3-VL-2B, the four quantized configurations reached their first token in 116-124 ms, against 130 ms at 16 bits (Table 8 ), differences smaller than the standard deviation across requests. LLaVA-1.5-7B started much more slowly, at 464 ms, because it processes 576 visual tokens against 128-256 for Qwen3-VL-2B and prefills them through a larger language backbone. Weight-only quantization reduced its TTFT by 10-23%, whereas W8A8-SmoothQuant reduced it by 46%, to 248 ms. This is the only case in which quantizing activations clearly helped, and it occurred in the model whose prefill is long enough for 8-bit arithmetic to pay off.
blocks.zh: 一个模型在发出出它的第一个令牌之前,它必须编码图像并处理快件,这个阶段被称为"预填"(图3. 量子化在这里帮助较少,原因有两个: 视觉编码器完全在预填时运行,在每个配置中仍为16比特,而预填时会同时处理所有输入符,因此它受到计算的限制,而不是控制解码的内存流量的限制. 对于Qwen3-VL-2B,四个被量化的配置以116-124 ms达到第一地标,而以16 bits(表8 )达到130 ms,差异小于各项请求的标准偏差. LLaVA-1.5-7B开始慢得多,在464ms上,因为它处理576个视觉符号,而Qune3-VL-2B则处理128-256个视觉符号,并通过更大的语言主干来预先填充. 重量唯量化将其TTFT减少了10-23%,而W8A8-SmoothQuant则减少了46%,为248 ms. 这是唯一一个对活化进行量化明显帮助的案例,它发生在模型中,其预填时间足够长,可以使8位算术得到回报.

blocks.en: 4.3.3 End-to-end latency
blocks.zh: 4.3.3 端到端延迟

blocks.en: Because every request generated exactly 64 tokens, end-to-end latencies in Table 8 are directly comparable across configurations. Quantization reduced the response time from 1.54 to 0.78 s for Qwen3-VL-2B (1.97 × \times ) and from 5.45 to 1.97 s for LLaVA-1.5-7B (2.77 × \times ), with W4A16-AWQ the fastest configuration for both models. Decoding accounted for more than 80% of the response time in every configuration, so decoding speed, not TTFT, determined the ranking (Figure 3 illustrates the two phases). For example, W8A8-SmoothQuant gave LLaVA-1.5-7B its fastest first token (248 against 359 ms for W4A16-AWQ), but its full response took 3.14 against 1.97 s because it decoded 1.8 × \times more slowly. As decoding becomes faster, TTFT accounts for a larger share of the response: for both models, it rises from 8.5% at 16 bits to 15.9% (Qwen3-VL-2B) and 18.2% (LLaVA-1.5-7B) with W4A16-AWQ.

blocks.en: 4.3.4 Backbone comparison
blocks.zh: 4.3.4 后骨比较

blocks.en: The choice of backbone had a larger effect on deployment cost than the choice of quantization (Table 8 ). Even unquantized, Qwen3-VL-2B occupied less weight memory than the most compressed LLaVA-1.5-7B configuration (3.96 against 4.20 GiB) and was faster than every LLaVA-1.5-7B configuration: it reached its first token in 130 ms against at best 248 ms, decoded at 22.3 against at best 25.5 ms per token, and completed a 64-token answer in 1.54 against at best 1.97 s. At equal precision the gap widened. With both models at W4A16-AWQ, Qwen3-VL-2B used 2.09 × \times less memory, reached its first token 2.9 × \times sooner, decoded 2.45 × \times faster, and completed a 64-token answer 2.5 × \times sooner. Quantization reduced inter-token latency by at most 3.1 × \times within a model, which was not enough for any LLaVA-1.5-7B configuration to match the unquantized Qwen3-VL-2B. Because the two fine-tuned backbones reach the same answer quality (Section 4.1 ), backbone selection was the dominant efficiency decision in this study and quantization the secondary one.

blocks.en: 4.4 Accuracy-efficiency trade-off
blocks.zh: 4.4 准确效率取舍

blocks.en: Figure 4 plots all ten configurations against weight footprint (a) and inter-token latency (b). Answer quality spans only 1.8 ROUGE-L points across the set, whereas memory and decoding speed differ by more than a factor of six. Efficiency, rather than answer quality, therefore separates the configurations.
blocks.zh: 图4按重量足迹(a)和间距(b)绘制了所有10个配置图。 答题质量跨度仅为1.8个ROUGE-L分,而内存和解码速度相差超过6个系数. 因此,效率而不是回答质量问题,将配置分开。

blocks.en: Because the two backbones reach equivalent answer quality, the comparison between them rests on efficiency, where Qwen3-VL-2B is the clear choice. At 8 bits, it remains within 0.2 ROUGE-L of every LLaVA-1.5-7B configuration while requiring about 37% less memory, reaching its first token at least 2.0 × \times sooner, and decoding at least 1.6 × \times faster. Quantizing the larger model further does not change this conclusion, because even its 4-bit configurations remain more expensive than the compact model at 8 bits.
blocks.zh: 由于两个骨干达到等同的答案质量,它们之间的比较依赖于效率,其中Qune3-VL-2B是明确的选择. 在8位时,它保持在每个LLaVA-1.5-7B配置的0.2 ROUGE-L范围内,同时需要约37%的内存,至少更早地达到其第一个令牌 2.0 ×\时间,并解码至少1.6 ×\时间更快. 进一步量化更大的模型不会改变这个结论,因为即使是它的4位配置仍然比紧凑的模型在8位时还要昂贵.

blocks.en: Among the Qwen3-VL-2B configurations, three are dominated. The 16-bit model is outperformed by W8A16-RTN, which preserves its answer quality (99.8% of full-precision ROUGE-L) while using 33% less memory and decoding 1.53 × \times faster, so full precision offers no practical advantage. W4A16-RTN is outperformed by W4A16-AWQ, which has an identical footprint and decoding speed but scores 0.67 ROUGE-L higher. W8A8-SmoothQuant lies marginally above W8A16-RTN at equal footprint (Figure 4 a), but the 0.07-point difference is too small to be meaningful, and W8A16-RTN decodes 1.3 ms per token faster, completes a 64-token answer 75 ms sooner (Figure 4 b), and requires no calibration data. SmoothQuant’s one advantage is the lowest TTFT of the five Qwen3-VL-2B configurations, but over a 64-token answer it finishes 75 ms behind W8A16-RTN and 340 ms behind W4A16-AWQ.
blocks.zh: 在Quen3-VL-2B配置中,有3个为主. 16位模型的性能被W8A16-RTN所超越,它保持了它的解答质量(99.8%为全精度ROUGE-L),同时使用更少的33%的内存并解码出1.53×\times更快,因此全精度没有实际优势. W4A16-RTN的性能被W4A16-AWQ所超越,其脚印和解码速度相同,但得分为0.67 ROUGE-L更高. W8A8-SmoothQuant位于W8A16-RTN上方,足迹相等(图4a),但0.07-分差太小,无法产生意义,而W8A16-RTN更快地解码为每令牌1.3 ms,更快地完成一个64-token回答75 ms(图4b),不需要校正数据. SmoothQuant的一个优势是5个Qwen3-VL-2B配置中TTFT最低,但超过一个64个音量的回答完成后W8A16-RTN后75分,W4A16-AWQ后340分.

blocks.en: Recommended configurations. Two configurations therefore remain. W8A16-RTN is essentially lossless, retaining 99.8% of full-precision ROUGE-L on PlantExpertVQA and matching full precision on IP-VQA, and requires no calibration data. W4A16-AWQ gives up a further 1.2% of ROUGE-L in exchange for a 24% smaller footprint and 29% lower inter-token latency than W8A16-RTN, requiring only 2.01 GiB of weights and completing a 64-token answer in 0.78 s. We therefore recommend Qwen3-VL-2B with W8A16-RTN as the default PlantVLM-Edge configuration, and W4A16-AWQ where memory is the binding constraint or where longer answers make decoding speed the priority.
blocks.zh: 建议配置. 因此,仍有两个组合。 W8A16-RTN基本上没有丢失,在PlantExpertVQA上保留了99.8%的全精度ROUGE-L并匹配了IP-VQA上的全部精度,不需要校正数据. W4A16-AWQ又放弃了1.2%的ROUGE-L,以换取24%的足迹和29%比W8A16-RTN更低的相接间空位,只需要2.01个重心的GiB,并在0.78 s完成64个相接的回答. 因此,我们建议以W8A16-RTN作为默认的PlantVLM-Edge配置的Qune3-VL-2B,而以W4A16-AWQ作为内存的约束或者较长的答案使得解码速度成为优先级.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The results show that a compact VLM, once adapted to the target domain, can match a model more than three times its size on agricultural question answering, and that post-training quantization then lowers its deployment cost further at little or no loss in answer quality. This section discusses what these findings imply for building edge-deployable diagnostic systems, translates them into deployment recommendations, and outlines the limitations of the present study.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,一个紧凑的VLM,一旦适应目标领域,就可以在农业问题回答上比出一个模型大小多出三倍多,训练后量化再进一步降低部署成本,在回答质量上很少或没有损失. 本节讨论这些调查结果对建立边缘可部署诊断系统的意义,将其转化为部署建议,并概述本研究的局限性。

blocks.en: 5.1 Domain adaptation and backbone selection
blocks.zh: 5.1 领域调整和骨干选择

blocks.en: Domain adaptation was the decisive step for answer quality. Fine-tuning raised ROUGE-L by 62.1-62.7 points on PlantExpertVQA and by 24.2-28.2 points on IP-VQA (Table 5 ), whereas no quantized configuration changed aggregate ROUGE-L by more than 1.8 points. After adaptation, the two backbones were indistinguishable in aggregate answer quality on both datasets, despite LLaVA-1.5-7B having more than three times as many parameters. Our fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-2B reached 78.18 ROUGE-L on PlantExpertVQA, compared with 61.70 reported by the dataset’s authors for the same model fine-tuned on 500 images ( Sakib et al., 2026 ) . The figures are not directly comparable, because the evaluation subsets and training settings differ, but the gap is consistent with the larger training subset used here and supports the authors’ observation that the dataset enables efficient domain adaptation.
blocks.zh: 领域调整是回答质量的决定性步骤。 微调将ROUGE-L在PlantExpertVQA上提升了62.1-62.7分,将IP-VQA上提升了24.2-28.2分(表5),而没有量化配置将ROUGE-L的总和改变了1.8分以上. 适应后,两个主干线在两个数据集的总答质量上是无法区分的,尽管LLaVA-1.5-7B的参数是三倍多. 我们的微调Qwen3-VL-2B在PlantExpertVQA上达到了78.18 ROUGE-L,而数据集的作者为500个图像上的同一种模型(Sakib等,2026年)进行了微调的61.70。 这些数字不具有直接可比性,因为评价子集和培训环境不同,但差距与此处使用的较大的培训子集是一致的,并支持作者的意见,即数据集能够有效调整领域。

blocks.en: For edge deployment, this reorders the usual priorities. Because the adapted backbones reach the same answer quality, the choice between them rests on efficiency, and there the compact model was smaller and faster at every bit-width, decoding 2.4-3.6 × \times faster than LLaVA-1.5-7B at equal precision (Table 8 ; Figure 4 ). The larger model’s better tolerance of 4-bit quantization did not close this gap: even unquantized, Qwen3-VL-2B was smaller and faster than every LLaVA-1.5-7B configuration. Backbone selection was therefore the dominant efficiency decision in this study, and quantization the secondary one. Because the two backbones also differ in architecture and pretraining, we interpret this as evidence that a compact model is sufficient for these tasks, rather than as a general effect of model size. A controlled comparison, such as models of different sizes from the same family, would be needed to separate the effect of model size from that of architecture and pretraining.
blocks.zh: 对于边缘部署,这重新排序通常的优先级. 由于被改造后的主干线达到相同的解答质量,它们之间的选择取决于效率,在每一个位宽时,紧凑的模型都更小更快,解码2.4-3.6×\时速也快于LLaVA-1.5-7B等精度(表8;图4). 更大的模型对4位分量化的更好的可耐性并没有弥合这一差距:即使没有分量化,Qun3-VL-2B比每个LLaVA-1.5-7B配置都更小更快. 因此,选取后骨是本研究中最主要的效率决定,并量化了次要效率决定。 由于这两个骨干在建筑和预训上也有所不同,我们将此解释为一个紧凑的模型足以完成这些任务的证据,而不是模型大小的一般效果. 需要进行有控制的比较,例如不同大小的模型和同一家族的模型,以区分模型大小与建筑和预训的效果。

blocks.en: 5.2 Bit-width versus quantization method
blocks.zh: 5.2 位宽与量化方法

blocks.en: Bit-width and quantization method played distinct roles. Bit-width determined deployment cost: configurations at the same precision had identical weight footprints (Table 4 ), and the two 4-bit configurations decoded at the same speed (Table 8 ). The quantization method mattered mainly for answer quality, and only at 4 bits on the compact backbone, where AWQ recovered 39% (PlantExpertVQA) to 56% (IP-VQA) of the loss incurred by round-to-nearest. At 8 bits, every method was effectively lossless, and the data-free W8A16-RTN matched the calibrated SmoothQuant in answer quality. Activation quantization gave no decoding benefit under single-user serving and helped only the compute-bound prefill of the larger model.
blocks.zh: Bit-width和量化方法发挥了不同的作用。 Bit-width确定部署成本:同一精度的配置有相同的重量足迹(表4),两个4位配置以相同的速度解码(表8). 量化方法主要针对答题质量,仅在紧凑骨干上4位时,AWQ回收了39%(PlantExpertVQA)至56%(IP-VQA)的来回相近所造成的损失. 8比特时,每个方法实际上都是无损失的,无数据W8A16-RTN在答题质量上匹配了被校正的平滑量. 激活量化在单一用户服务下没有解码好处,只帮助计算附加了较大模型的预填.

blocks.en: The comparison between datasets carries a methodological implication. The larger relative loss under 4-bit round-to-nearest on IP-VQA, and the wider gap between AWQ and round-to-nearest there (Tables 6 and 7 ), suggest that quantization studies on highly templated benchmarks may understate the cost of low-bit deployment on more varied question distributions. Since questions from growers in the field are likely to be more varied than either benchmark, evaluations of compressed agricultural models should include datasets with diverse, free-form answers.
