blocks.en: 5.3 The role of the serving stack
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 服务堆栈的作用

blocks.en: The latency benefits of quantization depend on the software that executes the quantized model, not only on the bit-width. In our vLLM deployment, 4-bit weights reduced inter-token latency by 2.14 × \times for Qwen3-VL-2B and by 3.11 × \times for LLaVA-1.5-7B (Table 8 ). In contrast, Shin et al. (2026) found on Jetson Orin devices that 4-bit quantization of small VLMs could slow token generation because of the overhead of dequantizing weights. The same bit-width can therefore speed up or slow down generation depending on the quantization format and inference kernels, which is why PlantVLM-Edge evaluates complete configurations end to end on the target device rather than inferring speed from model size.
blocks.zh: 量子化的暂时性好处取决于执行量子化模型的软件,而不仅仅是比特-width. 在我们的 vLLM 部署中, 4- 位重将 Qwen3- VL-2B 的相接间隔时间减少2. 14 ×\ ; LLaVA- 1.5-7 B 的相接间隔时间减少 3. 11 ×\ 时间(表 8 ) 。 相形之下,Shin等人(2026年)在Jetson Orin设备上发现,小VLM的4位分量化会因为分量分量分量分量的超高而使符号生成速度放慢. 同样的比特-width因此可以根据定量格式和推论内核来加速或减速生成,这就是为什么PlantVLM-Edge评价完整的配置结束于目标设备上而不是从模型大小推断出速度的原因.

blocks.en: The results also identify where the next latency gains lie. Once decoding is faster, time to first token becomes a larger share of the response (Figure 3 ): for a 64-token answer from Qwen3-VL-2B, it rises from 8.5% at 16 bits to 15.9% at 4 bits. Time to first token barely changed under quantization, because the vision encoder, which runs during prefill, remained at 16 bits in every configuration. Compressing the vision encoder is therefore the most direct next step for reducing latency, together with serving engines optimized for the Jetson platform, such as TensorRT-LLM.
blocks.zh: 结果还查明了下一个长期收益所在。 一旦解码速度快了,去先令的时间就成为了响应的更大份额(图3): 对于从Qune3-VL-2B得到的64个接通的回答,从16位的8.5%上升到了4位的15.9%. 第一次表示的时间在量化下几乎没有变化,因为预填时运行的视觉编码器仍然保持在每个配置的16位. 因此,压缩视觉编码器是减少延迟性的最直接的下一步,再加上为Jetson平台所优化的服务引擎,如TensorRT-LLM.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
This paper presented PlantVLM-Edge, a quantized vision-language framework for conversational crop health diagnosis that runs entirely on edge devices. The framework adapts a pretrained VLM to agricultural question answering with LoRA, compresses it with post-training quantization, and serves it on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin through an offline, browser-based chat interface. We instantiated it with two backbones, Qwen3-VL-2B and LLaVA-1.5-7B, on plant disease (PlantExpertVQA) and insect pest (IP-VQA) diagnosis, and evaluated four quantization configurations for both answer quality and on-device efficiency.
Three main findings emerge. First, domain adaptation determines answer quality, whereas quantization costs little: fine-tuning raised ROUGE-L by 24-63 points, 8-bit quantization changed it by at most 0.3 points, and 4-bit AWQ retained at least 98.6% of full-precision ROUGE-L for both backbones on both datasets. Second, bit-width determines memory and speed, whereas the quantization method matters only for answer quality at 4 bits on the compact backbone, where AWQ outperformed round-to-nearest. Third, backbone selection matters more than quantization: the fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-2B matched LLaVA-1.5-7B in answer quality while being smaller and faster at every bit-width. In its most compact form, PlantVLM-Edge requires 2.01 GiB of weights and completes a 64-token diagnostic answer in 0.78 s. We recommend Qwen3-VL-2B with W8A16-RTN as the default configuration and W4A16-AWQ where memory is limited. Future work will compress the vision encoder, evaluate Jetson-optimized serving engines and lower-cost devices such as the Jetson Orin Nano under multi-user load, and assess diagnostic correctness through expert evaluation and field trials with growers.
blocks.zh:
本文介绍了PlantVLM-Edge,这是完全在边缘装置上进行的对话作物健康诊断的定量视觉语言框架。 框架将一个预先训练的VLM与LORA的农业问题解答相适应,用训练后量化来压缩,并通过离线的浏览器聊天界面在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上服务. 我们用两个骨干,即Qune3-VL-2B和LLaVA-1.5-7B,对植物病(PlantExpertVQA)和昆虫病(IP-VQA)的诊断进行了即时分析,并评价了答题质量和答题效率的4个定量配置.
得出了三个主要结论。 首先,域位适应决定了答案质量,而量化成本很少:微调提升了ROUGE-L的24-63分,8位的量化最多改变了0.3分,4位的AWQ在两个数据集上都保留了至少98.6%的全精度ROUGE-L. 第二,比特-width决定了内存和速度,而量子化方法只对紧凑骨干上4比特的答题质量有影响,AWQ的表现超过了圆-近. 第三,骨干选择比量化更重要:精细的Quen3-VL-2B在回答质量上与LLaVA-1.5-7B相匹配,同时在每个位宽上都更小更快. PlantVLM-Edge在最紧凑的形态中要求有2.01GiB的重量并完成0.78 s的64个托克诊断答案. 我们推荐以W8A16-RTN为默认配置的Quen3-VL-2B和内存有限的W4A16-AWQ. 未来工作将压缩视觉编码器,评价Jetson-最优化的服务引擎和成本较低的装置,如多用户负载下的Jetson Orin Nano,并通过专家评价和与种植者进行实地试验,评估诊断正确性.
